name: Viking Electronics
old_description: You have questions. We have user forums, product docs, and American technicians ready for your call.
about:
Viking Electronics has been designing and building security and communication products for over 55 years from its headquarters in Hudson, Wisconsin. The privately held company operates all engineering, production, and shipping functions at that single Midwestern location.

The product line exceeds 500 items, spanning emergency phones, entry systems, paging interfaces, amplifiers, mass notification systems, hotline phones, auto dialers, enclosures, and a growing portfolio of SIP‑compliant VoIP endpoints. Every unit is designed, manufactured, and tested in‑house, with the company’s Enhanced Weather Protection (EWP) process encapsulating entire circuit boards in a clear polymer to withstand extreme outdoor conditions.

Primary markets include K‑12 schools, university campuses, commercial facilities, and public‑address installations where reliable voice communication and access control are critical. Customers range from district‑level IT directors to security integrators specifying Viking’s IP‑based intercoms, panic buttons, and multicast paging adapters.

Viking differentiates itself by keeping all support staff in Hudson — no outsourced call centers — so technicians can draw on decades of field experience when answering product questions. A two‑year limited warranty covers the entire catalog, and new product development is driven directly by installer and end‑user feedback collected through forums and direct technical calls.
